lead.en: Nine libraries, one greeting, no socket and no database. Each layer contributes a line to the output, and reading the nine lines in order is the shortest tour of what the stack is.
lead.zh: 九个库、一句问候、不开端口、不连数据库。每一层在输出里贡献一行，按顺序读完这九行，就是这一栈最短的导览。

foot.zh: 第 08 章 / 共 10 章

text.en: One program, everything in process. It is the chapter you can hand to someone who has ten minutes and wants to know what this family of libraries is for.
text.zh: 一个程序，全部在进程内。这一章适合交给只有十分钟、又想知道这一族库到底做什么的人。

out: moonapi : 200 then 304 — 0 octets the second time
moonorm : SELECT id, name FROM greets WHERE name = ?
moonmuse: prompt 'Greet heke1228 in one sentence.'

text.en: Eleven lines, nine libraries, and one of them speaks twice because a conditional request is answered twice.
text.zh: 十一行、九个库；其中一个说了两次，因为一次条件请求被回答了两次。

rows.en: Read the `.api` text into a spec: one service, one route, one type.
rows.zh: 把 `.api` 文本读成 spec：一个服务、一条路由、一个类型。

rows.en: Built the request value the whole stack speaks, without a socket.
rows.zh: 造出整栈都说的那个请求值，不用 socket。

rows.en: Mounted `/api/v1` once and made every route inside it relative.
rows.zh: 把 `/api/v1` 挂一次，里面的路由都变成相对路径。

rows.en: Matched the path, bound `name`, produced the body.
rows.zh: 匹配路径、绑定 `name`、产出响应体。

rows.en: Weighed the conditional headers and answered with a status instead of a body.
rows.zh: 比较条件头，用一个状态代替响应体作答。

rows.en: Rendered the address it would bind — the only line that is not a run.
rows.zh: 渲染出它会绑定的地址 —— 唯一一行不是真的跑。

rows.en: Built the statement and its parameters; `?` is where the value goes.
rows.zh: 拼出语句和参数；`?` 就是值要去的位置。

rows.en: Encoded the greeting as a length-prefixed gRPC message.
rows.zh: 把问候编成长度前缀的 gRPC 消息。

rows.en: Executed a query against the schema and returned the document.
rows.zh: 对着 schema 执行查询，返回文档。

rows.en: Rendered the template — the text a model would receive.
rows.zh: 渲染模板 —— 模型会收到的文本。

rows.en: Answered through a scripted provider: same call, no network, no key.
rows.zh: 由脚本化提供者作答：同样的调用，不联网、不要密钥。

text.en: That the layers are separable. Nothing here needed a port, a database file or an API key, because each library exposes a value you can build and hand to the next one by hand.
text.zh: 各层是可分的。这里不需要端口、数据库文件或 API 密钥，因为每个库都暴露一个可构造的值，你可以手动交给下一个。

title.en: Where the demo is thinner than the service
title.zh: 这个演示比真实服务薄的地方

text.en: The nine-in-one program stops at the seam where a real deployment would keep going: the SQL is built but not executed, the gRPC message is encoded but not sent, the prompt is answered by a scripted provider. Chapters 1 to 7 are the parts that do run.
text.zh: 全家桶停在真实部署会继续往前走的那条缝上：SQL 拼出来但没执行，gRPC 消息编好但没发出去，提示词由脚本化提供者作答。真正跑起来的部分在第 1 到第 7 章。

text.en: Read it as a map rather than a demo. Every line names the library that produced it, which is the whole reason it exists.
text.zh: 把它当地图读，而不是当演示。每一行都点出了产出它的库 —— 这正是它存在的全部理由。

items.en: Delete one of the nine blocks and run it again. The program still builds, and the output loses exactly one line — the layers do not depend on each other in the order you expect.
items.zh: 删掉九块里的一块再跑。程序照样能编，输出只少一行 —— 各层之间的依赖并不像你预期的那样成链。

items.en: Change `who` and read which lines move. The spec does not; everything downstream does.
items.zh: 改掉 `who`，看哪几行动了。spec 不动，下游全动。

items.en: Name the library behind each line of the output.
items.zh: 说出输出里每一行背后是哪个库。

items.en: Explain what one request passes through, in order.
items.zh: 按顺序说出一次请求经过了什么。

items.en: Say which parts of the demo would need a socket, a file or a key to become real.
items.zh: 说出演示里哪些部分要变成真的需要端口、文件或密钥。

items.en: Use the program as a map when you forget which library does what.
items.zh: 忘记哪个库干什么时，把这个程序当地图用。
